name: Skulker
description:
You are an expert at slinking through shadows. You gain the following benefits:
- You can take the Hide action as a Minor Action
- When you are hidden from a creature and miss it with a ranged weapon attack, making the attack does not reveal your exact position.
- Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
